title: Reduce progress WebView flat exports
summary: Removed four transitional flat progress WebView exports and moved the remaining callers to mediaPipelineProgressView namespace access.
reason: WebView flat window exports are a remaining cleanup workstream. The progress module already exposes the affected helpers through its namespace, so the unused/single-caller flat aliases can be retired without changing backend-owned behavior.
behavior_before: progressView.js exposed renderAuditProgressInto, renderPipelineEvents, renderHomeActiveWork, and renderLiveRunStrip both on mediaPipelineProgressView and as flat window aliases; app.js/reportsView.js and one browser smoke still referenced progress helpers as flat globals.
behavior_after: The four progress helpers remain available through mediaPipelineProgressView only. app.js, reportsView.js, the WebView browser smoke, the generated contract baseline, and the global export inventory now use or document namespace-first progress access.
manual_validation: npm run webview:contract && npm run webview:contract:check - passed

npm run webview:map:check && npm run webview:slices:check && npm run webview:dom-gaps:check && npm run webview:routes:check && npm run webview:commands:check && npm run webview:script-order:smoke - passed after regenerating stale generated artifacts
python -m unittest ApplicationFacadeWebStaticTests progress/bootstrap targeted methods -q - passed
rollback_plan: Restore the four window.* assignments in progressView.js, revert the app/reports/test namespace call-site changes, then regenerate the WebView public contract and refresh generated summaries.
notes:
Reduced progressView transitional flat exports and moved app/reports/browser smoke callers to namespace-first progress access.
Refreshed generated WebView command-boundary, godfile, and split-candidate artifacts after progress export cleanup.
Refreshed generated summaries for regenerated WebView analysis artifacts.
Generated summary for the new change packet.
Full ApplicationFacadeWebStaticTests class was attempted but not used as this slice gate because unrelated settings-string expectations fail outside the progress export cleanup.
